summary: Extreme expiry-week volatility; Nifty swung 150-200 pts intraday around 17,000. Bank Nifty down ~3,000 pts in a week; Credit Suisse crisis and Adani hangover cited; Reliance hit 52-week low a third straight day.

events.claim: India lost 11% of its market capitalization from January to March 2023, the worst-performing major market globally (Bloomberg report cited)
Bank Nifty fell about 3,000 points between consecutive Thursdays in March 2023
Reliance Industries hit a 52-week low for the third straight session, touching around 2,200

lessons: Markets are most volatile at range extremes - size positions for violent two-way moves near major support.
Three monthly red candles usually precede a green fourth, but March 2023 broke the pattern.
quote: Markets will be highly volatile either at the top end of the trading range or at the bottom end of the trading range.
leaks: Hope you enjoyed watching this video (outro boilerplate)

summary: Overnight US bank rescue (First Republic, $30B deposits) sparked short covering; ECB hiked 50bp as expected. India -11% market cap YTD, worst globally. 17,000 seen as 50% retracement support; sell dips below 16,800.

events.claim: Major US banks deposited $30 billion into First Republic Bank in March 2023
European Central Bank raised interest rates by 50 basis points in March 2023
FIIs sold about 5 lakh crore over two years; excluding Vinod Adani-linked inflows (~1.5 lakh crore), real FII selling was ~6.5 lakh crore
India was the worst-performing market in 2023 YTD with an 11% market-cap loss while most other markets gained

lessons: In extremely oversold markets, gap-ups may sustain - wait for confirmation before fading them.
Straddle premium approximates the expected range, and can be blown out by violent moves.
quote: For the last many months consistently people have been selling 17000 put option and have been making money, but this time they are in trouble.

summary: Bank Nifty swung ~1,400 pts intraday before Friday short covering lifted it ~600 pts. TCS fell on CEO resignation. FIIs sold 1,800 cr. History: after four monthly red candles the fifth was always green in 15-20 years.

events.claim: TCS fell on the resignation of its CEO (Rajesh Gopinathan resigned March 2023)
March 2023 series opened around 17,900 and traded below 17,000 in the final week

lessons: Shorts rarely carry over weekends - Friday afternoons often see short covering after a week of declines.
After four consecutive monthly red candles the fifth month has historically been green.
quote: If you make a mistake from Monday to Thursday, you just lose one day's sleep. But if you make a mistake on Friday, you lose three days.

summary: UBS-Credit Suisse rescue ($3.2B) and coordinated six-central-bank dollar liquidity (first since 2008) lifted US futures, but Asia fell anyway. China cut RRR. Fed 25bp expected; advised hedged spreads around 16,750-17,250.

events.claim: UBS agreed to buy Credit Suisse for about $3.2 billion in March 2023
Six central banks announced coordinated US-dollar liquidity action - the first such coordinated action since 2008
China cut the reserve requirement ratio and kept lending rates unchanged in March 2023
US Fed was expected to raise rates 25 basis points at its March 2023 meeting

lessons: When shorts are extreme, any good news gets an outsized reaction - size event trades for violence.
Hedged credit spreads keep risk defined through binary central-bank events.
quote: I think this kind of coordinated banking action has happened only in 2008.

summary: Nifty broke Thursday's low, fell ~350 pts, then recovered with Europe. Credit Suisse fell ~60% post-deal. Reliance hit 2,180 - its March-2022 Ukraine-war low. FIIs sold 2,500 cr; DIIs matched.

events.claim: Credit Suisse shares fell about 60% after the UBS acquisition terms were announced
Reliance Industries hit 2,180, matching its low from the March 2022 Ukraine-war selloff
Infosys broke 1,400, moving close to its 52-week low of 1,355

lessons: When blue chips return to crisis-era lows, long-term holders are exiting - sentiment, not just price, is broken.
Global banking stress hits Indian IT via BFSI exposure even when NASDAQ rallies.
quote: The Russian-Ukraine war low and today Reliance has gone to that low. You can imagine the kind of bearishness.

summary: Global markets green but SGX subdued - India 'fragile'. FIIs ~91% short in index futures, historically a contrarian signal. Bajaj Finance/Reliance down 20-40% from highs; only ITC and L&T up over the past year.

events.claim: FIIs held about 91% short positions in index futures in March 2023 - an extreme reading
Bajaj Finance and Bajaj Finserv fell roughly 30-40% from their highs without stock-specific negative news
Nifty 50 delivered roughly zero return over the trailing one-year period, with only ITC and L&T positive

lessons: When FIIs hold extreme short positions, markets have historically rallied within weeks - fade the crowd, not the tape.
Watch for the script-change day: flat open, shorts cover, dips get bought.
quote: No matter where the market is, they just keep selling, selling, selling.
dup_flag: FII-selling drumbeat repeats across this whole week

summary: Calm after the storm: modest Reliance-led rally; banks stabilized. But FIIs still sold (14 of 17 March sessions) - GQG's 15,400 cr Adani purchase masks larger underlying selling. VIX fell but did not crash.

events.claim: GQG Partners bought about 15,400 crore of Adani Group shares in early March 2023
FIIs were net sellers in 14 of the first 17 sessions of the March 2023 series

lessons: A rally that fails to take out the prior high with FIIs still selling is short covering, not reversal.
Read net FII figures net of one-off block deals like the GQG-Adani purchase.

summary: S&P above 4,000 and US VIX down ~12% pre-Fed - markets expect no nasty surprise. India held back by 91% FII shorts hedged via put writing and call buying. Planned neutral: 17,200/17,300 call spread financed by 16,800 put.

events.claim: S&P 500 crossed 4,000 and the US VIX fell about 12% ahead of the March 2023 Fed meeting
Infosys traded at 1,382, about 27 rupees above its 52-week low of 1,355

lessons: A VIX crash before an event signals the market expects no negative surprise.
A debit call spread financed by a short put captures upside while capping risk.
quote: No matter what you do the market will prove you wrong.
leaks: I am not a SEBI registered person

summary: Broad mild rally (about 45 of 50 Nifty stocks green) but below Friday's high; IT ultra-bearish; top private banks HDFC, ICICI, Axis plus SBI all fell despite a green tape. Fed decision due that night; 40,000 Bank Nifty straddle crowded.

events.claim: Infosys fell to 1,382, about 25 rupees above its 52-week low, on US banking crisis exposure concerns and brokerage downgrades
HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank and SBI all fell on a day the broader market rose

lessons: Index strength with top-weight stocks falling is distribution - trust internals over the index print.
Far-month premium refusing to decay signals event-risk pricing, not complacency.

summary: Fed hiked 25bp as expected but Powell's hawkish 'more hikes if needed' crushed an initial 400-pt NASDAQ euphoria - an 800-pt swing. India faces expiry-day volatility, opening below the prior low; Infosys and HDFC Bank the heavyweights to watch.

events.claim: US Fed raised rates 25 basis points in March 2023 and Powell signalled further hikes if needed
NASDAQ swung roughly 800 points intraday around the March 2023 Fed decision

lessons: The central-bank tone after the decision moves markets more than the decision itself.
An opening below the prior day's low is a technical red flag - let the panic settle before deciding.
quote: If the markets are moving higher, they come and give some hawkish comment... they don't want the market to go up significantly.

summary: Expiry-day whipsaw: Nifty -100/+170/crash; Bank Nifty swings of 1,000+ pts. Reliance, Kotak, SBI, HDFC Bank weak; Vedanta -5% on a denied sale rumor. His 16,800-17,300 neutral combo intact above the 16,800 floor.

events.claim: Vedanta fell about 5% on a rumor that Anil Agarwal might sell the company; the rumor was denied
Bank of England and the Swiss National Bank raised interest rates in March 2023

lessons: If the first four weeks of a series are volatile, expect expiry week to be worse.
Defined-risk combos convert a wrong directional view into a scratch, not a disaster.
leaks: Delta Exchange account link promo (crypto segment)

summary: US whipsaws on regional-bank fear; Yellen's mixed signals add volatility. FIIs 89% short in futures - extreme. Nifty futures premium collapsed from ~100 pts to under 10; India -10% YTD vs world ~+1%. Infosys 52-week low watch.

events.claim: US bank deposit insurance covers only up to $250,000, fueling fears about larger deposits
FIIs held about 89% short positions in index futures in March 2023
Nifty futures premium collapsed from about 100 points at the start of March to under 10 points
Kotak Bank traded below 1,700, near two-year lows

lessons: Futures premium collapsing toward discount signals extreme bearish positioning - historically a bottoming tell.
A regulator's mixed messaging amplifies volatility more than the underlying problem.
quote: It is not the selling, it is a lack of buying.

summary: STT headline confusion (1,700 vs 2,100 vs 5,000 per crore for options) plus Deutsche Bank -13% and European bank downgrades broke 17,000 decisively. Everything red; series low 16,830 just ~100 pts away.

events.claim: A government notification confusion over options STT (reported 1,700 to 2,100 per crore) hit sentiment; options STT had actually been raised to 5,000 per crore in 2016
Deutsche Bank shares fell about 13% and European banks were downgraded by US brokerages in late March 2023

lessons: Headline confusion, not the policy itself, moves markets - trade the clarification, not the rumor.
Tax hikes at fragile-market turns are doubly bearish because FIIs can trade the same index offshore.
quote: Stock markets will always react extremely for both negative as well as for positive news.

summary: US futures higher on First Citizens buying SVB and expanded emergency lending; Deutsche recovered half its fall. India: Kotak at two-year low, ICICI the only strong bank. Advised 16,700/16,600 hedged put selling with double-premium stops.

events.claim: First Citizens Bank agreed to buy Silicon Valley Bank's assets in late March 2023
The Fed was considering expanding its emergency lending program for banks

lessons: Crises end not with an announcement but with a stretch of days carrying no bad news.
Set stop-losses at double the collected premium when selling options into event weeks.

summary: First Citizens' SVB deal sent US bank stocks up ~40%, but Indian banks sold off - ICICI and Axis heavy selling; last-half-hour collapse (40,000 straddle 120 to 50). Adani circuit-to-circuit again; internals ugly, Reliance carrying the index.

events.claim: First Citizens Bank shares rose about 40% after the Silicon Valley Bank acquisition
Several Adani Group stocks (Total Gas, Transmission, Wilmar) hit lower circuits again in late March 2023
The 40,000 Bank Nifty straddle collapsed from about 120 to 50 rupees in the last half hour

lessons: When global bank stocks rip and Indian banks fall, a violent Indian bank-led rally is being stored up.
A last-half-hour collapse after a hopeful day shows institutions selling into retail optimism.
quote: Forty thousand bank nifty straddle from 120 rupees came to 50 rupees just in the last half an hour.

summary: Fin Nifty expiry; NSE mulling near-daily expiries (Bank Nifty Monday, FinNifty Tuesday, midcap Wednesday, Nifty Thursday) - a volatility machine. Adani lower circuits again; 17,000 straddle ~150 pts; World Bank 'lost decade' warning.

events.claim: NSE was planning weekly expiries across multiple indices on different weekdays (Bank Nifty Monday, FinNifty Tuesday, midcap Wednesday, Nifty Thursday)
HDFC planned to raise 57,000 crore via private placement ahead of the HDFC Bank merger
World Bank warned the global economy faces a 'lost decade' of growth
FIIs were net sellers in 12 of the previous 13 trading sessions

lessons: Expiry-day proliferation structurally raises volatility and shortens investor horizons.
Big-institution forecasts (like gold at $3,000) are routinely wrong - keep your own discipline.
quote: Many people are losing faith in long term investment and they are switching to short term and intraday trades.

summary: Adani saga resurfaced: a report questioned claimed loan prepayments (no exchange filings); Adani stocks -5% to lower circuits. FIIs' 1,530 cr buying suspected to be Adani-specific. Nifty slid to ~16,950 despite 50% retracement support.

events.claim: A report alleged Adani's claimed loan prepayments were not reflected in exchange filings as required
Adani Enterprises and Adani Ports fell more than 5% while several other Adani stocks hit lower circuits
NSE sought clarification from Adani Group on prepayment disclosures

lessons: Markets punish unverified claims about repayments - 'scam' is the one word they cannot ignore.
A support level that fails to bounce on the first serious test usually fails entirely.
quote: Stock markets do not like one word - scam.

summary: Adani confusion deepens (NSE query, bridge-loan extension report). Debt-MF tax change seen shifting ~$36B to bank deposits; Bank Nifty down 5,000 pts from 44,500. Flat open may precede a big expiry move; put ratio 17,100/16,900 running.

events.claim: Adani said loan prepayments are reflected in quarterly exchange filings after NSE sought clarification
Economic Times reported Adani was seeking an extension on the bridge loan taken for the ACC/Ambuja acquisitions
Removal of debt mutual fund indexation benefit was expected to shift deposits (~$36 billion) toward banks

lessons: Tax-law changes redirect capital at scale - follow the flows, not the headline.
Flat opens after extreme volatility often precede the biggest moves.
quote: Sometimes markets make a bigger move when it opens flat.

summary: Monthly expiry day: fierce fight at 17,000; Nifty closed above it and Bank Nifty above 40,000. Adani Enterprises +~10%. VIX collapsed ~10%, premiums crushed. Fourth straight monthly red - only the third such streak in 25 years.

events.claim: Nifty logged a fourth consecutive monthly decline in March 2023 - only the third such streak in 25 years (after 2001 and 2015); the fifth month rallied strongly on both prior occasions
Adani Enterprises rallied about 10% as the market accepted Adani's clarification on prepayments
India VIX collapsed about 10% into the March expiry
SEBI's extra 5% exposure margin on options expiring beyond 9 months lapsed for the December 2023 series

lessons: After four straight monthly falls - a 25-year rarity - the fifth month rallied strongly both prior times.
When the market reverses, VIX collapse delivers option-selling profits on both legs.
quote: Hope is the worst enemy in stock market.
dup_flag: Title-dated 29-Mar but content describes the 30-Mar monthly expiry session
leaks: most of the volume is controlled by myself and my workshop participants

summary: Global rally day 4-5 on Alibaba (+15%) restructuring and fading bank crisis; India VIX near multi-year low despite a 2,000-pt fall - downside likely limited. RIL demerger news (Jio Financial); April series only 17 sessions.

events.claim: Alibaba announced a major restructuring and its shares rose about 15%
Reliance announced the demerger of Jio Financial Services
Nifty fell nearly 2,000 points without a corresponding VIX spike, unlike Lehman or COVID

lessons: A crash without a VIX spike suggests limited downside - the panic valve never opened.
Six stocks carry roughly half of Nifty; their individual setups are the index setup.

summary: March closed as a doji month (<1% down). Quarter-end window dressing suspected: DIIs bought 2,500 cr, FIIs 350 cr, yet Nifty +350 pts in two days - Reliance, Infosys, ICICI contributed over half. 17,255 resistance broken; 17,800-18,000 next.

events.claim: Eurozone inflation came in better than expected; European markets closed higher for a fifth straight day
March 2023 closed as an almost flat (doji) month after three red months
Reliance, Infosys and ICICI Bank contributed more than 50% of the Nifty rally on 31 March 2023

lessons: Quarter-end windows get dressed: judge rallies after the quarter turns.
A doji after consecutive down months often precedes a large directional move.
quote: We can say the markets will be moving significantly higher from here or significantly lower - on a monthly timeframe.
leaks: Dalal Street Week Ahead program reference

summary: OPEC+ surprise cut (~1M bpd, Saudi 500K) sent crude +5% - good for Reliance/ONGC, bad net for India. GST second-highest ever (1.6 lakh cr). Friday's rally questioned as window dressing; RBI policy Thursday.

events.claim: OPEC+ announced surprise production cuts of about 1 million barrels per day (Saudi Arabia 500,000) and crude rose more than 5%
India GST collections hit their second-highest level ever at about 1.6 lakh crore (March 2023 collection)

lessons: Crude spikes split the market: producers rally, importers bleed - trade the split, not the headline.
The first quiet 45 minutes after a flat open decide the bias for weeks.
dup_flag: OPEC cut and GST points repeat across 1588/1590/1592

summary: FY24 opened soft, then recovered; premiums collapsed (Dec-2023 18,000 straddle 3,400 to under 1,400 - over 1 lakh/lot since Sep). Autos led (Hero +3%); Infosys stuck near 1,400. His 17,800 CE / 16,800 PE dip-buy worked.

events.claim: The December-2023 18,000 straddle collapsed from a combined 3,400 premium (September 2022) to under 1,400
Hero MotoCorp rose about 3% on monthly sales; autos were the best-performing sector

lessons: Ultra-low premiums punish both naked buying and naked selling - use defined-risk ratios instead.
Buy the first dip of an established uptrend; finance it, don't gamble it.
quote: Don't try this kind of things. You'll burn your fingers very easily.

summary: US dipped on soft data (job openings at two-year low); media narratives reverse-engineer moves. JPMorgan CEO warns banking-crisis effects will linger; cryptos rallied toward BTC 30K. Windfall tax on local crude cut to zero - Reliance/ONGC/Vedanta focus.

events.claim: US job openings fell to a two-year low and manufacturing PMI came in below expectations
JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon said the banking crisis impact will be felt for years
India cut the windfall tax on locally produced crude to zero and halved the diesel export duty
The US dollar index fell to about 101, near a two-month low

lessons: Media reasons follow price, not the reverse - trade levels, not narratives.
Government tax nudges like a windfall-tax cut are sentiment signals worth watching.
quote: Markets do not fall or rise because of the reasons; the reasons follow the market fall or rise.

summary: Surprise rally led by HDFC twins (+2.5% on business update), L&T, ITC, IT - not Reliance. FIIs bought 806 cr with retail aligned; DIIs sold. L&T strength read as a capex/economy tell; BHEL below book value after a block deal.

events.claim: HDFC and HDFC Bank rallied about 2.5% on a positive business update (deposit and loan growth)
A large block deal occurred in BHEL, with the stock trading below book value around 68-69 rupees
FIIs were net buyers of about 806 crore while DIIs sold about 947 crore

lessons: Capital-goods leadership tends to lead the real economy by six to twelve months.
When retail aligns with FIIs against DIIs, rallies extend - know all three flows.
Never carry big positions into a central-bank meeting for small premium.
quote: The domestic institutions and FIIs, these two are two big gangsters, and retail is the third gangster.
